race.description: Melbourne Cup Day Marquee Tickets On Sale Hcp (58+)
race.comment: CANTILEVER (1) gets the nond as he builds into the campaign nicely, landing here third-up and ready to peak. He's placed in both previous third-up attempts and he looks to get every chance from the draw. There's plenty to like about him and he profiles as the one to beat. GILES (2) brings a stronger set-up than his last-start fourth suggests, having raced wide throughout before returning to a trip where he has already won. Can feature in the finish. FORBIDDEN APPLE (5) has to be respected after beating Shoot To Fame and CANTILEVER at this venue last start. DUTCH POR (4) can feature in the finish third-up into the campaign.
